name: app-dark-sneaker-product-card-with-light-inset
title: Dark Sneaker Product Card
whatItIs: A charcoal card with a pale rounded image panel holding a white sneaker, a heart button, name and brand in white, a large price and a white rounded cart button.
whatItMeans: A dark card holding a bright product panel makes the product the hero and keeps the interaction points obvious.
techniques: Light inset image on a dark card for strong contrast
Circular favourite button on the image corner
Large price paired with a big square action button
Truncated title with ellipsis to keep a fixed height
Soft shadow lifting the card off pale grey

vocabulary.definition: A picture placed in a rounded box within a card.
A square button holding a single icon.
Cutting off long text with an ellipsis.
